name: trazum
description: Where your LLM bill actually goes: thirteen priced findings per prompt — caching, model tier, batching — offline and deterministic.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trazum/core && npm run build -w @trazum/cli && npm run build -w @trazum/mcp && npm run build -w @trazum/tokenizer-openai && npm run build -w trazum-vscode
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trazum/core && npm run test -w @trazum/cli && npm run test -w @trazum/mcp && npm run test -w @trazum/tokenizer-openai && npm run test -w trazum-vscode && npm run test -w @trazum/web && npm run test:action && npm run test:agents && npm run test:release
scripts.test:release: node --test test/sbom.test.mjs test/release-assets.test.mjs test/install-snippets.test.mjs test/homebrew-formula.test.mjs test/pricing-dataset.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trazum/core && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/cli && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/tokenizer-openai && npm run typecheck -w trazum-vscode && npm run typecheck -w @trazum/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build -w trazum-vscode && node scripts/release-assets.mjs vsix --out apps/vscode
